events.title: Salinas voters scheduled to decide referendum affecting repeal of rent-related ordinances
events.impact: The vote can determine whether prior rent-stabilization, tenant-protection and rental-registration rules remain repealed or are restored; treat as a binary local policy catalyst.
events.property_scope: Property coverage follows the underlying Salinas rent-stabilization / tenant-protection / registry ordinances; referendum outcome determines whether those regimes remain repealed.

events.title: San Pablo Measure S scheduled for vote on proposed local rent-control ordinance
events.impact: Measure S asks voters whether to adopt a separate rent-control ordinance capping covered residential increases at the lower of 60% of CPI growth or 3%, with additional eviction/housing rules. This is distinct from the City’s adopted >7% Rent Review / mediation program.
events.source: City of San Pablo — 2026 General Election
events.property_scope: The ballot question applies to some residential rental units; exact exemptions/coverage must be read from the proposed ordinance before underwriting.

events.title: NYC 2026–27 rent-stabilized renewal period begins: 0% for one-year leases and 1.75% for two-year leases
events.impact: Directly constrains renewal growth for covered rent-stabilized apartments and lofts for leases commencing Oct. 1, 2026 through Sept. 30, 2027: 0% for one-year renewals and 1.75% for two-year renewals.
events.property_scope: NYC rent-stabilized apartments and lofts subject to RGB Order 58; not general market-rate housing.

events.title: Federal judge preliminarily blocks New York landlord-side algorithmic rent-setting restriction
events.impact: A preliminary injunction prevents enforcement of the challenged landlord provision while RealPage’s constitutional case proceeds. This is litigation posture, not a final merits ruling or repeal of the broader statutory framework.
events.property_scope: Residential landlords/property managers that would otherwise be subject to the challenged New York restriction on using covered algorithmic rent-setting recommendations; it is not a conventional rent cap.

events.title: Santa Barbara City Council votes 4-3 to introduce Residential Rent Stabilization and Rental Registry ordinance
events.impact: Would add a local rent-stabilization and rental-registry regime if finally adopted. Council retained an annual adjustment formula of 60% of CPI or 3%, whichever is less; the introduced ordinance returns Oct. 6, 2026 for adoption.
events.property_scope: Proposed residential rental coverage is ordinance-specific. Council previously directed exemptions including deed-restricted affordable housing and Housing Choice Voucher tenancies; final scope should be checked after adoption.

events.title: Oregon publishes 2027 maximum annual rent increase of 10% for most covered tenancies
events.impact: The 2027 ceiling for the ORS 90.323 / ORS 90.324(b) category rises from 9.5% in 2026 to 10% in 2027; the statutory property-age exemption remains material.
events.property_scope: Most residential tenancies subject to ORS 90.323, excluding units meeting statutory exemptions such as first certificate of occupancy less than 15 years before the notice; separate manufactured-dwelling/marina rules apply.

events.title: San Pablo adopts Rent Review Program for rent increases above 7% in a 12-month period
events.impact: Adds a local review/mediation process for significant rent increases without imposing a rigid rent cap; program begins Jan. 1, 2027.
events.property_scope: Residential rent increases that meet the ordinance's covered-tenancy criteria and exceed 7% in 12 months; ordinance-specific eligibility should be checked before underwriting.

events.title: San Luis Obispo considers amendments to mobilehome park rent stabilization rules
events.impact: Property-type-specific regulation: changes concern mobilehome park space rents and transfer-related rules rather than conventional multifamily apartments.
events.property_scope: Mobilehome park space rents subject to the city's Mobile Home Park Rent Stabilization Ordinance.
